name: Orrin Graves
source:
An injured man found by Nellie and Cybill in the woods. After bringing him in Weissfield Monastery, Sisters decided to take care of him.
He's a merchant.

[spoiler]He purposfully spread rumors about a "monster" and asked Cybill to play along.[/spoiler]
